issues.claim: train a spatial salinity-risk model only on TloCare’s historical 18,000 GPS/lab points plus covariates

sources.quote: Rezultati koje klijent vidi odnose se na pH, fosfor, kalijum, humus i potrebu za kalcifikacijom, uz preporuku za đubrenje po parcelama.
Imamo GPS koordinate svih dosadašnjih uzoraka i laboratorijske rezultate za oko 18.000 tačaka iz poslednjih deset godina.

issues.explanation: The material never states that the historical laboratory results include salinity-relevant analytes (ECe/ESP/EC); the only residues the company names are pH, P, K, humus and calcification need, so a salinity-risk model may have no usable labels. Add 'which analytes and depths exist in the 18,000 records (notably ECe/ESP)' to the data-audit step and state that training is contingent on it.

issues.claim: Proposed researcher contribution: model design and validation; company contribution: data, field access and dense reference sampling.

sources.quote: Problem je što gušće uzorkovanje znači više terena, više laboratorijskih troškova i duži rok isporuke — a cena usluge nam već pritiska granicu prihvatljivosti za klijenta.
Imamo dva programera i jednog GIS specijalista koji mogu da odvoje do trećine radnog vremena za razvoj novih funkcija, uz povremenu podršku terenske ekipe za testiranje u polju.

issues.explanation: Dense reference sampling is exactly the cost the company says it cannot bear, and its stated R&D capacity covers developers, one GIS specialist and only occasional field-team testing. Mark the company's dense-sampling contribution explicitly as unconfirmed and conditional on the budget question, rather than listing it as an assigned contribution.
